hadiths.english_translation: Narrated: The Prophet ﷺ said regarding the month of Ramadan: Indeed this month has come, and it is a blessed month. Allah has made fasting it obligatory. hadiths.english_translation: Narrated: We were with 'Umar ibn al-Khattab in Ramadan, and the sky was cloudy. We were brought sawiq (a type of drink/food) and the sun appeared. So 'Umar said: 'Allah has protected us' or 'Allah has made us independent from your evil. Indeed, we did not send you as a shepherd for the sun, but we sent you as a caller to prayer. O people! Whoever has broken his fast, then making up one day is easy, and whoever has not broken his fast, let him complete his fast.'

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated: Abu Bakr ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham said: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever is reached by the dawn while in state of janabah (ritual impurity), then there is no fast for him.' So my father and I went and entered upon 'Aishah and Umm Salamah, and we asked them about that. They both informed us that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wake up in a state of janabah not from a wet dream, then he would fast. Then we entered upon Marwan and informed him of their statement and the statement of Abu Hurayrah. He said: 'I adjure you both to go to Abu Hurayrah and inform him of their statement.' We met Abu Hurayrah at the door of the masjid. My father said to him: 'The Amir has adjured us in a matter to mention it to you.' He said: 'What is it?' My father narrated to him. Abu Hurayrah's face changed color, then he said: 'Thus al-Fadl ibn al-'Abbas narrated to me, and he knows better.' Al-Zuhri said: 'So he transferred the hadith to someone else.'

$7199  7201 /2 /141 عَنْ /94 مَعْمَرٍ L7633 /94 ، عَنِ /26 الزُّهْرِيِّ L7272 /26 ، عَنْ /26 أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ L118 /26 ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " مَنْ أَدْرَكَهُ الصُّبْحُ جُنُبًا ، فَلا صَوْمَ لَهُ ، قَالَ : فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَأَبِي ، /27 فَدَخَلْنَا عَلَى /93 عَائِشَةَ L4049 /93 /15 /93 وَأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ L8101 /93 /15 فَسَأَلْنَاهُمَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ ، فَأَخْبَرَتَانَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ /20 يُصْبِحُ جُنُبًا مِنْ غَيْرِ حُلْمٍ ، ثُمَّ يَصُومُ " /27 ، قَالَ : ثُمَّ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى مَرْوَانَ ، فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ بِقَوْلِهِمَا ، وَقَوْلِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، فَقَالَ :    @ 4 : 180 @   عَزَّمْتُ عَلَيْكُمَا لِمَا ذَهَبْتُمَا إِلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، فَأَخْبَرْتُمَاهُ بِقَوْلِهِمَا ، قَالَ : فَلَقِيَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ عِنْدَ بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي : إِنَّ الأَمِيرَ عَزَّمَ عَلَيْنَا فِي أَمْرٍ لِنَذْكُرَهُ لَكَ ، قَالَ : وَمَا هُوَ ؟ قَالَ : فَحَدَّثَهُ أَبِي ، قَالَ : فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : هَكَذَا ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْعَبَّاسِ ، وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ : فَحَوَّلَ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ * 
$7200  7202 /2 /141 عَنِ /94 ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ L5223 /94 ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي /26 ابْنُ شِهَابٍ L7272 /26 ، عَنْ /26 أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ L118 /26 ، عَنْ /26 أَبِيهِ L4304 /26 ، /27 عَنْ /93 أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ L8101 /93 ، /15 /93 وَعَائِشَةَ L4049 /93 /15 أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ /20 يُدْرِكُهُ الْفَجْرُ ، وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ ، ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ ، فَيَصُومُ " /27 *

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated: Ibn Jurayj said: 'Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Bakr ibn 'Abd al-Rahman informed me, from his father, who said: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying in his storytelling: 'Whoever is reached by dawn while in a state of janabah, then let him break his fast.' [The narrator continues discussing how this was corrected by reference to what the Prophet ﷺ actually said.]
